title: Skardyn
wikitext:
[[File:Thromrar Darkflame.png|thumb|300px|[[Thromrar Darkflame]], a skardyn.]]
'''Skardyn''' are the cursed descendants of [[Dark Iron dwarves]] who had delved too deeply into the cursed depths of [[Grim Batol]] and survived the Dark Iron siege of the city, near the end of the [[War of the Three Hammers]]. Twisted by the vile magics of [[Modgud]], their bodies and minds corrupted until they became creatures of shadow and malice, far removed from their former selves.<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|39|The Skardyn}}</ref>
